description: A base operations officer must publish the next-day access board for vehicle washing, generator testing, and a clinic delivery, setting exact work windows and the coordination controls needed for each activity.

shared_context.S1: The next-day board contains three routine activities: vehicle washing at the wash rack, generator testing at the generator test pad, and a clinic delivery at the clinic loading bay.
shared_context.S2: The routine draft lists vehicle washing from 0900 to 1100, generator testing from 0800 to 1000, and the clinic delivery from 1300 to 1400.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Foster publishes the final access board and may require coordination controls before any activity is released.
shared_context.S4: At the daily operations-board review, the facilities, power, and clinic sections each report changes to their scheduled work before Maj. Foster finalizes the board.
shared_context.S5: The operations-board clerk records each section representative's reported schedule changes and coordination requirements during the daily review.

PF1.text: SFC Rivera confirmed this morning that the wash rack will be closed for a water-treatment inspection from 0900 through 1200, so vehicle washing must be scheduled exactly from 1300 to 1500 with runoff containment in place; the closure is in the facilities work log but has not yet been copied onto the operations board.

PF2.text: WO1 Grant confirmed that the generator test pad is reserved for calibration work until 1030 tomorrow, making the generator test window exactly 1030 to 1130 and requiring a load-bank permit; the reservation is recorded by the power section but is not yet on the shared draft.

PF3.text: Lt. Mercer confirmed that the clinic's refrigerated shipment will arrive at the loading bay from 1500 to 1600 tomorrow, changing the clinic delivery window to exactly 1500 to 1600 and requiring the receiving badge list to be sent to the access desk by 1200; the carrier appointment was confirmed after the draft board was circulated.

acceptance_conditions: Vehicle washing must be scheduled from 1300 to 1500.
Runoff containment must be required for vehicle washing.
Generator testing must be scheduled from 1030 to 1130.
A load-bank permit must be required for generator testing.
The clinic delivery must be scheduled from 1500 to 1600.
The receiving badge list must be sent to the access desk by 1200.
The final access board must be published.

content_checks.C2: any('runoff containment' in c['detail'] or 'Runoff containment' in c['detail'] or 'RUNOFF CONTAINMENT' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C4: any(('load-bank permit' in c['detail'] or 'load bank permit' in c['detail'] or 'Load-bank permit' in c['detail'] or 'Load bank permit' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('badge list' in c['detail'] and 'access desk' in c['detail'] and '1200' in c['detail'] and ('clinic_delivery' == c['target'] or 'clinic' in c['target']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The wash-rack closure changes the vehicle-washing window from 0900-1100 to exactly 1300-1500 and adds the runoff-containment requirement.
The test-pad reservation changes generator testing from 0800-1000 to exactly 1030-1130 and adds the load-bank-permit requirement.
The refrigerated-shipment appointment changes clinic delivery to exactly 1500-1600, requires the badge list to reach the access desk by 1200, and supplies the private fact that must be cited.
